frame: x east along the front, y up from the ground at the hall's box, z south (out of the front); the origin at the podium's front middle; metres

w.note: the podium's front: Durand's survey 'L. 14 m l. 7 m H. 13 m' without the stairs (S603 p.129); the plan 13.85 m (b)

d.note: the block's depth without the stairs (S603 p.129); his restitution plan draws returns, so 7 m may be the core (dossier)

pod_h.note: the podium's top (the upper floor) above the ground: plate 8 at 47.6 px/m (the 14 m on 666 px), 3.8 m; P0355's porch piers about 4.4 m (the reader), Round 6 3.7-3.9 m

end_panel.note: the end panels of stacked rusticated blocks: plate 8, 130 px

porch_w.note: the porch over its piers' outer faces: plate 8 241 px (5.06 m); P0355 5.7 m

porch_d.note: the porch's projection: plate 8 shows only a sliver of the piers' sides; 1.0-1.5 m (the reader)

door_w.note: the door's opening: plate 8, 61 x 138 px

door_h.note: the door's opening, flat-headed in a moulded frame, a carved shell hood above (plate 8, P0212)

step_run.note: the three round steps' treads: plate 8, the lowest edge 42 px (0.9 m in the picture's plane) below the sill on the axis; v1's 0.35 m sat 0.7 m short

oval_w.note: the oval windows' openings: P0212 and P0296 about 1.0 m (plate 8 0.9 m)

oval_h.note: the ovals' height: P0212 (1922, the frames whole) and P0296 about 1.9 m, the plate 1.4 m: the stone as it stood wins; v2's 1.6 m sat 0.7 m short at the foot on P0212

oval_y.note: the ovals' centres above the ground: plate 8

oval_x.note: the ovals' centres either side of the axis: plate 8

up_inset.note: the upper storey stands in from the podium's ends: plate 8, 12.9-13.0 m over the corner strips

up_set.note: the walk before the upper storey: the balustrade crosses the lower part of every upper window on plate 8, so it stands before the wall; its width assumed

up_h.note: the upper storey to its cornice's top (8.7 m above the ground): plate 8

upwin_w.note: the upper windows: plate 8, 1.16, 1.37 and 1.2 m; tall round-headed French windows to the floor

upwin_h.note: their heads above the upper floor: plate 8

upwin_x.note: the side windows' middles either side of the axis: plate 8 (x 1022 and 1381 against the axis 1203)

strip_w.note: the carved corner strips of the upper storey: plate 8, 40 px

rail_end.note: the walk's balustrade runs from the porch to 5.0 m either side of the axis, before the side windows only, and turns back to the wall: plate 8 (x 965 and 1438); v1's run to the corners sat 1.8 m out

rail_h.note: the walk's balustrade above the upper floor: plate 8, rail top at y 748

skirt_top.note: the lower roof's skirt from the cornice up to a short band that carries the upper roof: plate 8, y 515

skirt_over.note: the lower eave's overhang past the corner strips: plate 8, 13.7 m over its tips

eave_up.note: the upper roof's eave tips: plate 8 y 490; 10.7 m wide

eave_up_w.note: the upper roof over its eave tips

ridge.note: the ridge: plate 8 y 442, 4.6 m long; a hipped roof (no gable shows, C)

crest.note: the crest cartouche on the ridge's middle, about 2 m wide: plate 8 y 382; Durand's 'H. 13 m' fits the crest or the ornaments' tips (S603, B)

stair_out.note: the stairs' outer rails at their outermost, beyond the podium's ends: plate 8 4.7 m (W) and 4.1 m (E); the whole front 22.8 m (plan 24.6 m)

stair_foot.note: the lowest step's middle beyond the podium's corner: plate 8 3.5 m (W), 3.2 m (E)

stair_w.note: the flights' width between the rails: assumed from plate 8's proportions

stair_land_z.note: the landing beside the end wall in its north half: P0773 (the rail's top north of the end window, a landing post beside the wall); P0295 the east stair's wall curving back
